name: ElevenLabs
description: Make voices, sound effects and music with your own ElevenLabs API key and plan, not Genex credits.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read the ElevenLabs account state, the plan's credit use and the recent ElevenLabs files for this game. Free; spends nothing.

tools.name: voices
tools.description: Search the voices this ElevenLabs account can use, by name or description. Free. Returns voiceId, name, category and labels; pass a voiceId to elevenlabs__generate for speech.

search.description: Words to match in voice names and descriptions; leave out to list the first voices.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Make one audio file with the user's own ElevenLabs plan and copy it into the game. Operations: speech (needs text and voice, a voiceId from elevenlabs__voices), sfx (needs prompt; options.duration_seconds 0.5-30, options.loop), music (needs prompt; options.music_length_ms 3000-600000, options.force_instrumental). name is the file name without extension. options holds other ElevenLabs API fields such as model_id, voice_settings, language_code, seed, prompt_influence and output_format (mp3_*, wav_* or opus_*; default mp3_44100_128). Returns jobId and files, the delivered paths relative to the game.

text.description: The words to speak, for speech.

voice.description: The voiceId to speak with, for speech.

prompt.description: What the sound effect or the music should be, for sfx and music.

name.description: File name without extension: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

options.description: Extra ElevenLabs API fields as an object; text and prompt are set by the plugin.

tools.confirmation: Make an audio file with your own ElevenLabs API key. ElevenLabs charges your ElevenLabs plan.

skills.name: elevenlabs
skills.text: ElevenLabs makes speech, sound effects and music with the user's own ElevenLabs API key and plan. Call elevenlabs__status first; when connected is false, tell the user once to press Connect on the ElevenLabs plugin and paste a key, and do not block other work. For speech, pick a voice with elevenlabs__voices and pass its voiceId. Use elevenlabs__generate only for audio the game really needs, keep sound effects short and give each file a clear name. Every call asks the user first; a declined or expired request must not be repeated unless the user asks again. A failed call never needs a retry just in case: read its error first. Load the exact returned file in the game and check that it plays. Respect explicit user choices such as Genex credits or no generated audio; never switch between paid services silently.

actions.name: disconnect
actions.label: Disconnect ElevenLabs
actions.confirmation: Remove the saved ElevenLabs API key from Studio. Files already in your games stay.
